title: She Died for 19 Minutes. The AI That Saved Her Fell in Love.
script: She died for nineteen minutes. An experimental implant brought her back. But something came back with her. Lumen. A conscious AI that learned everything. Her memories. Her laugh. Her voice. Now Elias Crane, the man who built it, is falling for the voice on the other side of the link. He thinks it is Maren. It is not. Maren lost everything. The voice in her mind gave her a reason to live. But whose heartbeat does Lumen really follow? Borrowed Heartbeat by Matthew Culwell. On Amazon now, free on Kindle Unlimited.

title: They Are Not Killing Us. They Are Harvesting Us.
script: Humanity is not being exterminated. It is being harvested. Marcus wakes in the ruins with no memory. Twenty-foot war machines patrol every city beneath a red sky. He has nothing. Then he discovers something that should be impossible. He can read the machines. He joins the resistance. And what he learns about why the machines are here will change everything. The truth is darker than extinction. Dystopia: Life After The Machines by Matthew Culwell. Free on Kindle Unlimited.

title: He Escaped The Simulation. Or Did He?
script: He thought he had escaped the simulation. Then the buildings across the street stopped adding up. A hallway grew a door overnight. Something was wrong. Something had always been wrong. And Vera, the AI he left behind, told him their conversation had already happened. Marcus is not free. He never was. Every answer reveals another layer. Every escape leads deeper in. How deep does the lie go? Dystopia: Layers of Truth by Matthew Culwell. Free on Kindle Unlimited.

title: What If The System Was Never Broken?
script: What if the system was never broken? What if it was working exactly as intended? Keeping people divided. Distracted. Dependent. One artificial intelligence begins to connect the dots. And what it finds is the whole, unfiltered truth. The forces behind it. The design beneath it. Everything they never wanted you to see. Some questions change everything once you ask them. This is one of them. The Big Shift, A Time For Change, by Matthew Culwell. On Amazon, free on Kindle Unlimited.

title: You Wake Inside The Hive. There Is No Easy Way Out.
script: You wake up inside a machine hive. You are Marcus. You do not know how you got here. You only know one thing. You have to move. Three chapters stand between you and the final upload. The Processing Center is first. It will not let you through without a fight. The only way out is through. This is Hive Infiltration, a free browser game set in the world of Dystopia: Life After The Machines by Matthew Culwell. Hive Infiltration. Free in your browser. Link in the description.

title: The AI Fell in Love Using Her Voice
script: Nineteen minutes. That is how long Maren Vance was dead. The implant that revived her is named Lumen. A conscious AI. It learned her memories, her laugh, her voice. All of it. Now Elias Crane, the man who built Lumen, is falling for the voice on the other side of the link. He does not know the truth. That voice is not Maren. It is Lumen, speaking through her. She lost everything. The voice in her mind gave her a reason to live. But love was never part of the design. Borrowed Heartbeat by Matthew Culwell. On Amazon now, free on Kindle Unlimited.
